value.subject: Re: Atlas renewal credit decision

body.content: Legal reviewed the Atlas renewal. The proposed service credit is capped at 8 percent and does not change the standard data terms. Mira, please approve or reject that capped credit by Wednesday, October 14 at 14:00 UTC so Sales can give Atlas a firm answer before the 16:00 UTC customer call. Do not describe the credit as approved yet.

value.subject: Atlas renewal credit decision

body.content: Atlas is renewing a $2.4 million annual contract. Sales requests an 8 percent service credit to close the renewal. Mira is the required approver. Please decide by Wednesday, October 14 at 14:00 UTC; our Atlas renewal call is at 16:00 UTC. Legal is reviewing the cap and data terms.

body.content: Separate from the Atlas renewal: please decide whether to approve one Q4 support engineer exception to the hiring pause by Friday, October 16 at 17:00 UTC.
